decision_conditions: No site works or development shall commence until details of the levels of the building(s), road(s) and footpath(s) in relation to the adjoining land and highway(s), and any other changes proposed in the levels of the site, have been submitted to, and approved by, the local planning authority.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;line-height:normal;mso-layout-grid-align:
none;text-autospace:none"><span lang="EN-US" style="">Notwithstanding
the details shown on the approved drawings, the development hereby permitted
shall not commence beyond damp proof course level until there has been
submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority detailed
sections at metric scale 1:20 through all external reveals of the windows and
doors on each of the elevations. The development shall be completed in
accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter be retained.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></span></p>

All planting, seeding or turfing comprised in the approved details of landscaping shall be carried out in the first planting and seeding seasons following the occupation of the building(s), or the completion of the development, whichever is the sooner.  Any existing or new trees or shrubs which, within a period of 5 years from the completion of the development, die, are removed, or become seriously damaged or diseased, shall be replaced in the next planting season, with others of a similar size and species, unless the local authority agrees any variation in writing.

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin:0cm;mso-add-space:auto;line-height:
normal;mso-layout-grid-align:none;text-autospace:none">Nowithstanding the approved
details, the development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until the
following details have been submitted and approved in writing by the Local
Planning Authority:<o:p></o:p></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">a) Refuse storage including screening;<o:p></o:p></span></p><p>



</p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 6pt;"><span lang="EN-US">The development shall be completed in accordance with the
approved details and shall thereafter be retained.<o:p></o:p></span></p>
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;Covering Letter
dated 14<font face="Arial, sans-serif">th</font> May 2024; Planning Statement (April 2024); Demolition and
Construction Method (March 2024); Nocturnal Bat Survey (version 1.0) by MKA
Ecology; Preliminary Ecological Appraisal (BE-1753-02A) by DWA Ecology;<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;line-height:normal;mso-layout-grid-align:
none;text-autospace:none">Design Statement
(V.01-March 2024); Access Statement (March 2024); Heritage Statement (March 2024);
Drainage Strategy Report (21342-SYM-XX-XX-RPT-C-0001); Structural Condition
Report (21324– Rev G May 24); Arboricultural Impact Assessment and Method
Statement (BE-1753-01A); Willow Mead Biodiversity Matrix; Fire Safety Strategy (March
2024); P050A; P201A; P202A; P101; P102; P203; P204; P701; P702; P703; P002; P030;
P060; P100; S002; S099; S100; S101; S102; S105C; S201; S202; S303;S204; S001.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:6.0pt;line-height:normal;mso-layout-grid-align:
none;text-autospace:none">The development hereby permitted shall be used for
Class C3 dwellinghouse(s) only and notwithstanding the provisions of the Town
and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any
Order revoking or re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no
development within Schedule 2, Part 3, Class L shall take place.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></p>

<p class="MsoNormal"><span style="line-height: 107%;">Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country
Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (or any order revoking or
re-enacting that order with or without modification), no development which
would otherwise fall within Classes A, B, C, D, E and F in Part 1 of Schedule 2
to that Order shall be carried out in relation to the dwellinghouse hereby
permitted without the prior written permission of the local planning authority.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;line-height:normal">Prior to the commencement of any construction,
demolition or preparatory works, the applicant shall submit to the Council for
approval in writing a Construction Environmental Management Plan (CEMP)
focusing on biodiversity and wildlife which will provide full details of
measures and timings, including method statements, drawings and specifications
required in support of these, that will need to be implemented in order to: <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpFirst" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><!--[if !supportLists]-->a)<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->safeguard features of ecological
importance, including areas of semi-natural habitat, protected and priority
species known or likely to use the site and its features for foraging, shelter,
reproduction, commuting or other purposes, and the features of value to these
species;<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><!--[if !supportLists]-->b)<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->avoid impacts on habitats in areas
adjoining the development site, and at its boundaries in particular;<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><!--[if !supportLists]-->c)<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->ensure that contractors and those
responsible for overseeing the development will implement necessary measures in
full.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpLast" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><!--[if !supportLists]-->d)<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->A clear supervision / monitoring
program to ensure all contractors and those overseeing the development fully
implement the approved measures. To be overseen by an ecologist to supervise
sensitive activities and monitor compliance throughout demolition and
construction.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;line-height:normal">&nbsp;</p><p>











</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;line-height:normal">The development including site preparatory works,
demolition and construction works shall be undertaken in accordance with the
approved CEMP, in order to safeguard features of ecological importance,
including areas of semi-natural habitat, protected and priority species known
or likely to use the site and features for foraging, shelter, reproduction,
commuting or other purposes, on which they wholly or partly depend.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></p>

<p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US">Prior
to the occupation of the development hereby permitted, details of a cycle rack
system and their dimensions shall be submitted to and approved in writing by
the local planning authority. The development shall be completed in accordance
with the approved details and shall be thereafter retained.</span><span lang="EN-US"><o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style=""><span style="line-height: 107%;">Notwithstanding the approved plans, the development other than
demolition works, hereby permitted shall not commence until details</span><span style="line-height: 107%;"> <span lang="EN-US" style="">for the works for the
attenuation, storage and disposal of surface water to be provided on site have
been submitted to, and agreed in writing by, the local planning authority. The
development shall be carried out in accordance with the works so agreed and the
works shall thereafter be retained.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></span></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:6.0pt;line-height:normal">Notwithstanding the approved
plans, the development other than demolition works, hereby permitted shall not
commence until details of the works for the disposal of sewage to be provided on
site have been submitted to, and agreed in writing by, the local planning
authority. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the works so
agreed and the works shall thereafter be retained.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style=""><span lang="EN-US" style="line-height: 107%;">Notwithstanding the approved details, the development hereby permitted
shall not be occupied until there has been a scheme of hard and soft landscape
works for the site submitted to, and approved by the Local Planning Authority. <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style=""><span lang="EN-US" style="line-height: 107%;">Soft landscape works shall include: </span><span lang="EN-US" style="line-height: 107%;">planting
plans (at a scale not less than 1:100), schedules of plants, noting species,
plant sizes, plant container sizes (all at time of planting) and proposed
numbers / densities.</span><span lang="EN-US" style="line-height: 107%;"><o:p></o:p></span></p><p>



</p><p class="MsoNormal" style=""><span lang="EN-US" style="line-height: 107%;">Hard landscape
works shall include; details of boundary treatments including walls, fences and
gates (materials, scale of boundary, location), retaining walls (materials,
location, height) and details of hard surfacing materials to be used in the
landscaping of the site.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal"><span lang="EN-US" style="line-height: 107%;">Notwithstanding
the approved details, the development hereby permitted shall not progress
beyond damp proof course level, until details of the lighting of the
dwellinghouse and all external areas within the site has been submitted to the
Local Planning Authority. This includes all details of the lighting including
sourcing/ manufacturer details, location, height type, direction of light
sources, specification, elevations, light spillage and lighting levels The
development shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details and
shall be retained as such thereafter.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></span></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin:0cm;mso-add-space:auto;line-height:
normal;mso-layout-grid-align:none;text-autospace:none">The development
hereby permitted shall be undertaken in accordance with the Arboricultural Impact
Assessment and Method Statement (Section 4, AIA and AMS – BE-1753-01A) and plan
(TPP-1753-01A) subject to the pre-arranged tree protection monitoring and site supervision
as detailed in the report by the appointed arboricultural consultant, unless
otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></p>
The refuse bins shall be stored at all times, other than on collection days, in the designated refuse storage area, as shown on the approved drawing.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-right: 2.3pt;"><span style="line-height: 107%;">The
development hereby approved shall not be occupied until details of the
following have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority:<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpFirst" style="margin-right: 2.3pt;"><!--[if !supportLists]--><span style="line-height: 107%;">a)<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><!--[endif]--><span style="line-height: 107%;">Two
bird boxes to be installed on existing trees;<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="margin-right: 2.3pt;"><!--[if !supportLists]--><span style="line-height: 107%;">b)<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><!--[endif]--><span style="line-height: 107%;">Three
bat boxes to be installed on existing trees;<o:p></o:p></span></p><p>





</p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpLast" style="margin-right: 2.3pt;"><!--[if !supportLists]--><span style="line-height: 107%;">c)<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><!--[endif]--><span style="line-height: 107%;">Four
bat boxes to be incorporated into the new building.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></span></p>
description: Demolition and redevelopment to provide a two storey (5 bed) detached dwelling house; hard and soft landscaping
